author: Zintenka
body:
Been a long time since i made a map huh? *Chuckles* Well, I'm back. 

This was an old OCN map i made but now i edited it to suit Avicus standards. The old one was an "Attackers vs Defenders" map. 

Anyway, i added a lot of stuff to this map and made sure i copied YML from maps currently in rots to get the YML pretty accurate. 



Features:
  • 40 vs 40
  • Modified drops
  • TNT
  • 5 monuments
  • 4 indestructible supply areas including spawn
  • Powerful leather chestplate with 80% slowness (Dont hate plz, i added severe slowness.)
YAML

DOWNLOAD 

Imgur

Made by Zintenka

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Very interesting palette you went with.

Gonna be honest I really like the layout of the map but it just seems executed a bit poorly.

Looking at this picture (http://i.imgur.com/XKOPQLN.png) the map seems very flat which is not that great. The big letters (S E) in the back also seem very rushed.

Then looking at this picture (http://i.imgur.com/zXM5hD2.png) the room seems very blocky. The windows don't seem to fit IMO and just its chunky.

I do really like the bonuses you get for mining coal ore, emerald blocks, gravel and pumpkins. Those are very cool and could benefit the gameplay of the map.

Overall pretty nice map and looks like it could play very well. Nice layout and palette just it seems a bit too flat and some areas look rushed.
